extra_quotes: Printed logic circuits based on ECM memristors were fabricated using laser ablation (Trumpf TruMicro 5000) for Au bottom electrode patterning and inkjet printing for the active layer deposition and the top electrode (Ag) deposition.
The pulse amplitudes for initialization and logic operations are listed in Table I, where each pulse has a width of 200 ms, while the SET and XOR,1 pulses have a 3 mA compliance current.
All operation voltages in Table I were determined experimentally by scanning the operation range, taking into account the boundary conditions proposed in [9] and [10].

To evaluate workload-level throughput, we use a custom cycle-accurate simulator in which workloads are represented as Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs), with scalar additions as nodes and data dependencies as edges.
Although the success rates of NOR and XOR are limited by device variability, the presented results are intended as a proof of concept that requires further device optimization.
